newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian August money supply up 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian August money supply up 4.5 pct.

text.p: Lithuania's money supply rose 4.5 ercent in August to 5.4 billion litas, the central bank said on Thursday.
Currency in circulation came to just over two billion litas compared with 1.96 billion litas in July, the bank said in its monthly bulletin.

In a sign of more confidence in the banking sector after last year's crisis, time and savings deposits with commercial banks rose 3.4 percent in the month to 530.9 million litas while demand deposits rose 14.2 percent to 1.6 billion litas.
Interbank credits also rose during the month, amounting to 67.5 million litas after the previous month's 21.2 million litas.
It was the highest interbank lending total so far this year. Most loans, 61.5 million litas, were made up to one month.
